mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the lunar hypothesis into a specific prediction and testing it at the shore made inquiry tangible. The qualification that agreement supports a pattern without proving every detail was especially clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early inactive-object attempts and empty inspection were frustrating; they narrowed options but gave little indication of how to begin.

surprise.text: I was surprised that Wonder and Question had no available operations at first, despite seeming central to the goals. Language and Story had to develop the route instead.

arbitrary.text: Story combining with Starfield to make constellations was evocative, but I found it only through compatibility feedback after guessing Moon; its role in the calendar was clearer afterward.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what questions the community asks next, particularly because the final discovery can be shared and checked by others.
